tables:
  - Customer_Payment_Methods
      customer_id: int — customer id
      payment_method_code: str — payment method code values: 'Cheque', 'Credit Card', 'Direct Debit'
  - Customers
      customer_id: int — customer id
      gender_code: str — gender code values: 'Female', 'Male', 'Unknown'
      customer_first_name: str — customer first name
      customer_middle_initial: str — customer middle initial
      customer_last_name: str — customer last name
      email_address: str — email address
      login_name: str — login name
      login_password: str — login password
      phone_number: str — phone number
      address_line_1: str — address line 1
      town_city: str — town city
      county: str
      country: str values: 'USA'
  - Invoices
      invoice_number: int — invoice number
      invoice_status_code: str — invoice status code values: 'Issued', 'Paid'
      invoice_date: str — invoice date
  - Order_Items
      order_item_id: int — order item id
      product_id: int — product id
      order_id: int — order id
      order_item_status_code: str — order item status code values: 'Delivered', 'Out of Stock'
  - Orders
      order_id: int — order id
      customer_id: int — customer id
      order_status_code: str — order status code values: 'Cancelled', 'Delivered', 'Part Completed'
      date_order_placed: str — date order placed
  - Products
      product_id: int — product id
      parent_product_id: int — parent product id
      product_name: str — product name
      product_price: float — product price
      product_color: str — product color values: 'Red', 'Yellow'
      product_size: str — product size values: 'Medium', 'Small'
      product_description: str — product description
  - Shipment_Items
      shipment_id: int — shipment id
      order_item_id: int — order item id
  - Shipments
      shipment_id: int — shipment id
      order_id: int — order id
      invoice_number: int — invoice number
      shipment_tracking_number: str — shipment tracking number
      shipment_date: str — shipment date
